name: tran_gia_app
description: Tran Gia Food Delivery Platform - Hybrid Monorepo (Flutter + NestJS + Next.js)

scripts.db:create-cms: node -e "const p=require.resolve('pg',{paths:['./apps/cms','./backend']});const {Client}=require(p);const c=new Client({host:process.env.DATABASE_HOST||'127.0.0.1',port:process.env.DATABASE_PORT||5432,user:process.env.DATABASE_USERNAME||'postgres',password:process.env.DATABASE_PASSWORD||'postgres',database:'postgres'});c.connect().then(async()=>{try{await c.query('CREATE DATABASE trangiadelivery_cms;');console.log('Database trangiadelivery_cms created.');}catch(e){if(e.code==='42P04')console.log('Database trangiadelivery_cms exists.');else console.error(e.message);}c.end();});"
scripts.check: prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json,css,md,yaml,yml}" --ignore-unknown && pnpm --filter=!customer_app --filter=!shipper_app --filter=!restaurant_app --sequential --if-present run lint && pnpm --filter=customer_app --filter=shipper_app --filter=restaurant_app --sequential run lint
scripts.build: pnpm --filter=!customer_app --filter=!shipper_app --filter=!restaurant_app --sequential --if-present run build && pnpm --filter=customer_app --filter=shipper_app --filter=restaurant_app --sequential run build
